title: Roberto Santos Third Grade Teacher Victoria Cardenas Named Teacher of the Month
excerpt: Victoria Cardenas, a third grade teacher at Roberto Santos Elementary School with more than two decades in the classroom, was surprised Wednesday morning with the Teacher of the Month honor for her commitment to making every student feel heard, welcomed and valued.
content:
Victoria Cardenas, a third grade teacher at Roberto Santos Elementary School, was surprised Wednesday morning with the Teacher of the Month honor, recognizing more than two decades in the classroom.

Cardenas previously taught at Borchers and Col. Santos elementary schools before joining Roberto Santos Elementary, where she now teaches third grade.

Her nomination described a genuine commitment to ensuring every student feels heard, welcomed and valued, and Cardenas said she teaches kindness alongside academics.

She tells her students to follow the golden rule and to always do their best, even when nobody is watching, and to live with integrity.

Sources: Teacher of the Month announcement, Nov. 18, 2026.
